rows.text: Reflection’s founders on building a DeepSeek of the West Reflection is soon releasing Beam, its first open-weight AI model, in a bid to become the DeepSeek of the West. Trained from scratch, Beam is designed for coding, reasoning, and AI agents. Reflection's benchmarks put it alongside the strongest open models, with substantially more efficient token economics. To mark Beam’s debut, I'm joined by Reflection's co-founders: CEO @MishaLaskin, who led reward modeling for Google’s Gemini, and CTO @real_ioannis, who helped create AlphaGo and AlphaZero before leading Gemini’s RLHF effort.
